2121568821194412103.en_summary: I suspect Renaissance, a quant firm, didn't "know" about Jensen—they just followed their quant signals. Momentum peaked, vol spiked, so high-beta exposure got cut. Mark Stevens, a $NVDA board member, sold ~$946M of NVDA with no 10b5-1 plan—discretionary. Timing correlation ≠ insider trading, but worth pulling. (Quoted: Renaissance sold $1.42B of Nvidia weeks before Jensen quit, 13F 43 days late)
2121568821194412103.zh_summary: 我懷疑 Renaissance，一家量化公司，並不「知道」Jensen——他們只是跟隨量化信號。動量見頂，波動率飆升，因此高貝塔敞口被削減。Mark Stevens，$NVDA 董事會成員，賣出約 9.46 億美元 NVDA，無 10b5-1 計劃——自由裁量。時機相關不等於內幕交易，但值得深挖。(引用：Renaissance 在 Jensen 辭職數週前賣出 14.2 億美元 Nvidia，13F 晚了 43 天)
